visual.caption: 圖一｜Firewall、IPS 與 IDS 的角色
visual.description: 藍色實線為實際封包路徑；綠色虛線為防火牆前的鏡像副本。箭頭表示傳送方向，放行仍取決於政策。

items.title: 掃描端
items.body: 送出測試封包，記錄收到的回覆與掃描狀態。

items.title: Firewall
items.body: 依存取政策放行或拒絕，可記錄 Allow／Drop。

items.title: IPS（Inline）
items.body: 位於實際流量路徑，符合規則時可阻擋；須核對運作模式。

items.title: 受保護的伺服器
items.body: 提供 TCP 8443 測試服務，可核對連線及服務日誌。

items.title: IDS（被動鏡像）
items.body: 從掃描端至防火牆之間取得副本，產生告警；不在主流量路徑上。

visual.caption: Figure 1 | Firewall, IPS, and IDS roles
visual.description: Blue solid arrows show packet forwarding; the green dashed branch carries a copy from before the firewall. Arrows indicate transmission direction; forwarding depends on policy.

items.title: Scanner
items.body: Send test packets; record replies and scan states.

items.title: Firewall
items.body: Allow or refuse according to access policy; may log Allow/Drop.

items.title: IPS (inline)
items.body: On the forwarding path; may block a rule match. Verify operating mode.

items.title: Protected server
items.body: Provide the TCP 8443 test service; compare connection and service logs.

items.title: IDS (passive mirror)
items.body: Receive a copy between scanner and firewall. Generate alerts outside the forwarding path.

visual.caption: 圖二｜如何證明這次掃描被阻擋？
visual.description: 上層兩項觀察須共同進入下層交叉核對。箭頭表示查核步驟，不是封包路徑或單一紀錄足以證明的因果。

items.title: 掃描端｜09:02｜來源 B
items.body: TCP 8443 → filtered：尚無法判定入口狀態。

items.title: IDS｜09:02｜可疑掃描
items.body: Action: alert：已產生告警，尚未證明阻擋。

items.title: 防火牆紀錄｜FW-17
items.body: 同一來源 B、目標與 TCP 8443，Action: DROP；核對 NAT、時間與規則。

items.title: 服務端紀錄｜Server
items.body: 未找到 B 的對應連線；僅作旁證，須確認日誌收集完整性。

items.title: 有限度結論
items.body: 對齊來源、目標、時間、協定、Port 與路徑後，證據支持本次 B 流量受到 FW-17 阻擋；不能推論所有服務安全、IDS 擋下攻擊或沒有入侵。

visual.caption: Figure 2 | Was this scan blocked?
visual.description: Correlate both observations in the upper layer with both records below. Arrows show investigation steps, not packet flow or causation established by a single record.

items.title: Scanner | 09:02 | source B
items.body: TCP 8443 → filtered: the port state remains unresolved.

items.title: IDS | 09:02 | possible scan
items.body: Action: alert: a notification, not proof of blocking.

items.title: Firewall log | FW-17
items.body: Match B, target and TCP 8443, Action: DROP. Check NAT, time and rule.

items.title: Server records
items.body: No matching B connection found. Corroboration only; verify collection completeness.

items.title: Bounded conclusion
items.body: After matching source, target, time, protocol, port and path, evidence supports FW-17 blocking this B traffic. It does not establish all services are secure, IDS blocked the attack, or no intrusion occurred.
